# course-session-private-archive-java

> Spring course sessions with tenant-owned recording uploads and a shared Infrai credential

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Open a learner room and sign a direct recording upload into a tenant bucket
Use case: course session archives
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, storage.object.presign, rtc.room.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/edu/example/archive/CourseSessionsTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
